// lock: A throwaway sandbox needs no lockfile: `deno task check` would write deno.lock into a fixture that ships none and leave an untracked file behind.
// imports: Without this map the agent's test imports `jsr:@std/assert` inline, `deno lint` rejects it (no-import-prefix), and the run loops on lint until it stops (2026-10-04, `ship-task-reflect-push-declined` runs 1 and 3).

tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno test -A
